meta.frames: body x fwd, y left, z up; ZYX Euler (roll phi about x, pitch theta about y, theta>0 nose down); quaternion wxyz; gravity (0,0,-9.80665) m/s^2; leg order FL FR RL RR
meta.force_basis: cylinder force = contact force - rod weight; pressure reading = cylinder force - seal friction f
meta.slopes: ground roll/pitch in deg; diagN = N deg along the 45 deg diagonal (roll = pitch = N/sqrt2)
